theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbs_slice_identity_of_averages
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (RB : IMRep U n) (Rs : ℝ → IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → Measurable f → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, LocallyIntegrable (fun s => (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n))) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∫ s in a..b, (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = (b - a) * ((∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n])) → ∀ᵐ t, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, (Rs t).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
